name: gas-gmail-api
description: Google Apps Script POST API that sends Gmail with to, subject and HTML body

scripts.create: clasp create --type webapp --title "Gmail Send API" --rootDir src && node scripts/fix-clasp.js
scripts.deploy: clasp push -f && clasp deploy --description "Gmail Send API"
scripts.redeploy: clasp push -f && clasp deploy --deploymentId $DEPLOYMENT_ID --description "Gmail Send API update"
